channel.title: Elliott Olson – Writing
channel.description: Notes on evaluating models, building infrastructure, and the work around it.

item.title: What an evaluation score really tells you
item.description: A single number hides a lot of decisions. Some notes on what goes into one, and what to ask before trusting it.

item.title: Where the milliseconds go
item.description: Latency rarely has one cause. A way of breaking a request down until the slow part has nowhere left to hide.

item.title: A contract between systems
item.description: Why a small, boring interface is often the thing that lets everything around it change quickly.

item.title: The value of a boring nightly run
item.description: The most useful automation is the kind nobody thinks about until the morning it catches something.

item.title: What changed between intern and senior
item.description: Looking back at six years of the same job title getting longer, and what actually shifted along the way.
